properties.site-address: Garage court rear of Marybrook Street car park, Marybrook Street Berkeley
properties.notes: Main constraints: Existing garage use. Summary: The site is considered suitable for redevelopment for housing subject to providing adequate car parking for existing residents and future occupants. There is a reasonable prospect that the site will be available in the future and that development as envisaged will be delivered on the site within 15 years.. This site could be redeveloped for high density housing, comprising flats at an average density of about 60 dph, and the suggested yield is 5 units.
